source:
The protagonist is a pretty-faced boy.
He’s the kind of kid who radiates “bully me” energy from every pore.
And now, he’s been roped into the “Sabbat Research Club,” or “Saba Ken” for short.

Klotho: “Hey, Rinko. You’re being too rough. If you push him too hard, even the last guy we’ve got will run away.”

She plans to summon demons and bring the entire world to its knees.

Klotho: “Don’t take it personally. You’re just a test subject for our magic. Brace yourself. Yah!”
The protagonist is squeezed, drained, and wrung dry by their magical seduction techniques! Every conceivable form of erotic magic beyond human comprehension is unleashed on his d***.
But he won’t lose. His d***, and the “manly power” within it, will never surrender! Enduring the erotic onslaught from the two magical seductresses, his counterattack begins now!
